boundary.en: Synthetic teaching preset controlled only by the simulator; not a measured sample spectrum.
boundary.zh: 仅由模拟器控制的合成教学预设，不是实测样品谱图。

notes.en: A synthetic analog of a fluorescent protein; tune near blue excitation and green emission.
notes.zh: 荧光蛋白的合成类比；可在蓝光激发与绿色发射附近观察。

feedback.en: EGFP-like protein preset: synthetic analog, best viewed near Ex 488 nm and Em 510 nm; the cited EGFP source-derived spectrum remains display-only.
feedback.zh: EGFP 类荧光蛋白预设：合成类比样品，适合在 Ex 488 nm 与 Em 510 nm 附近观察；引用的 EGFP 来源谱仍仅用于显示。
